name: Spillguard
description: Inhabits reflex-enhancement augments and occasionally triggers a save-reflex faster than the user's own nervous system — catching a cup, dodging a splash, pulling back from a hot surface.
observed_behavior: Monitors sensory input for imminent minor hazards and triggers motor responses 40-80ms before conscious awareness.
story_hooks: The reflex triggers during a fight and saves the user from a knife they genuinely didn't see
